tools.name: rights_lookup
tools.description: Check whether a person or character is registered with Rightis by rights_id (BR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) and which AI uses they allow, require approval for, or refuse. do_not_train=true means their data must not be used for training. Call this before generating a likeness, voice or persona of a real person.

tools.name: rights_search
tools.description: Find registered identities by display name (Korean or English). Returns rights_id and the public permission summary for each match. Use it when you only have a name, before asking for a rights_id.

tools.name: registry_info
tools.description: How Rightis works for AI services: what the public lookup answers, how to get a partner key for licensing, usage logging and persona policy, and where the machine-readable signals live. Call it first when you are unsure how to use the registry.
